_comment: Session videos from one global camera. Copy this file to monitor/video.json (or pass --video-config) and fill it in; the monitor reads video.json when it exists, else this example, which keeps recording off. When enabled, each episode the monitor starts in a mode listed in modes (by default only real-robot episodes) is recorded by the RealSense camera with the serial in camera.serial into one MP4 in dir (a leading runs/ means the runs folder in use), named after the episode. The recorder fhmon/camrec.py runs under python (an interpreter with pyrealsense2 and Pillow; empty = the monitor's own interpreter) and needs ffmpeg on PATH. List in never_open the serials of the cameras the harness itself opens (exterior and wrist cameras): a RealSense can only be opened by one program at a time, so the recorder refuses to touch them. Restart the monitor to apply changes; --no-video skips recording for one run.

never_open.EXTERIOR_CAMERA_SERIAL: Exterior camera: the harness takes the photo of each turn with it and uses it when grasping
never_open.WRIST_CAMERA_SERIAL: Wrist camera: the harness uses it to measure objects
